title: Darmanin Apologizes Over Affaire Lyhanna: Judicial System 'Failed to Protect' Child
detail: French Interior Minister Gérald Darmanin issued an apology to the family of Lyhanna, a child victim, stating that the judicial institution 'failed to protect the child' ('n'a pas su protéger l'enfant'). The case has prompted significant scrutiny of child protection failures within the French justice system.
